It's been three months since I missed the client deadline and let Kashish down. I'm Varun. She had to stay up all night to save the project. I didn't even call.
The next morning I went to her desk. "I messed up. I didn't tell you I was behind. I'm sorry." She said "okay" and nothing else.
I didn't ask her to forgive me. I just kept doing what I said. Every task on time. Every update before she asked. I covered her Friday when her mother was ill.

It's not fixed. But it's coming back, slowly.

In the small town of Tiruvannamalai, Avni and Urmila had run a tailoring stall together for two years. In March, Avni took an order for twelve school uniforms and forgot to tell Urmila. The school shouted at both of them.
Avni went to Urmila's house that evening. "It was my fault. I forgot. I'll stitch all twelve myself, and I'll pay back the discount we had to give."
Urmila said, "Okay," and shut the door.

In September, Urmila handed her the key to the stall. "You open tomorrow."
